title: Socratic council
summary: N seats answer one brief independently, then question each other for R rounds. Each seat may delegate deep research to a fixed pool. A reducer writes the synthesis, a verifier checks it, the owner approves.

rounds.name: opening
rounds.rule: Independent openings. No seat sees a peer's text.

rounds.name: examination
rounds.rule: Each seat receives every peer's previous-round text verbatim, asks each peer one question that could falsify their claim, and answers the questions put to it. Retractions are explicit.

rounds.name: closing
rounds.rule: Each seat states its final position, what changed its mind, and remaining disagreement.

laws.rule: Every seat and pool class is an alias in patterns/routes.json.
Each alias's route satisfies routes.json routeLaws (GPT via fx/pi, Gemini via agy, free via vllm-sr).
Rounds, seats and pool counts are finite and inside the parameter limits; the plan reserves exactly that many leases.

Before round 1, every seat's exact route returns exit 0, non-empty text, usage success, and observed model == requested model. No substitution; a failed seat makes the council incomplete, not re-seated.
A seat turn needs the round token for its round; tokens are issued in order and a seat gets one turn per round. A turn for round R+1 is rejected.
A research spawn consumes one lease of its seat's class. A spawn with no remaining lease, an unlisted class, or depth > maxDelegationDepth is rejected.
Every turn and spawn reports the model that actually answered; it must equal the alias's model (free class: any model the router reports as a qualified free lane).
Examination rounds cite peers' previous-round turn ids; round 1 cites none.

measure.outcome: Owner verdict (keep / partial / drop) plus any task metric the brief declares. Patterns are compared only on the same brief family.
